review_method: Direct inspection of all fourteen listed source PNGs, not rendered Blender validation.

materials.notes: Detailed peach plaster with patch variation. Keep aggregate small; no excessive displacement.
Cream/teal/gold repeated fan design. Preserve motif orientation and physical repeat scale.
Vertical boards with dark grooves. Model panel joints; do not interpret dark grooves as validated height.
Visible overlap shadows and cylindrical tile shading. Geometry/finish direction only; not neutral base colour for raised tiles.
Sage square tiles with grout and occasional chips. Separate tile/grout response; seam repeat pending.
Coral/teal printed woven cloth. Bind to cloth UVs; avoid macro-sized weave.
Dark teal dense floral carpet. Limit high frequency detail at gameplay scale.
Dark aggregate and restrained patch variation. Wet reflections must come from shader/lighting.
Ivory terry loops with self-shadow. Surface direction; use restrained relief to avoid tangled macro loops.
Ivory paint chips and sparse wear. Base colour candidate; exposed-metal roughness requires separate mask.
Dark fine-grained rubber. Use restrained relief and nonmetallic shader.
Horizontal fine walnut grain. Align UVs to each furniture part; do not duplicate grain scale blindly.
Turquoise tiles with subdued chips. Independent water material; no water lighting baked into tile shader.
Ivory/sage checkerboard. Model geometry and tile scale consistent with reception; edge repeat pending.
